Maya (CS): Quick capture from Brightline onboarding call. They raised a few items that could affect renewal in ~4w: cost visibility, onboarding blocker, and a small UX ask.

Maya (CS): Raw asks we logged: 1) CSV export of per-route token usage + dollar breakdown for finance. 2) Shorter embedding TTL for dev routes (per-route override). 3) Onboarding flow doesn't show KMS/service-account verification step 1 clients stalled. 4) Console warning when reserved capacity >80%.

Iris (PM): Add impact? renewal in 4w so finance + blocking items higher priority.

Maya (CS): Impact notes: 1=high (finance report), 2=medium, 3=high (blocks go-live), 4=medium. Customer said finance needs the CSV to complete procurement.

Cal (Eng): Feasibility quick: CSV=small-medium, TTL override=small, KMS onboarding fix=small (UI + backend verify + docs), capacity warning=small. Security review needed for KMS.

Iris (PM): Proposed triage: P0=CSV export & KMS onboarding verification; P1=TTL override; P2=capacity warning (can be simple alert first). Agree?

Jon (SE): Workaround for CSV: share this one-liner to generate CSV from usage API:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=brightline&group_by=route&start=2026-07-01&end=2026-07-31" | jq -r '.routes[] | [.route, .tokens, .cost] | @csv' > brightline-jul.csv
```

Tess (Enablement): I can run a 30m assist tomorrow 9am PT to walk them through the KMS steps and share the CSV script. Can product add checklist copy to the onboarding modal as a short-term fix?

Cal (Eng): I'll pick up a 1d spike for KMS verify + security touchpoints and post findings here.

Maya (CS): I'll tell Brightline we have an enablement session + CSV workaround and product is prioritizing the KMS spike. They seemed relieved and will hold renewal discussion until after the assist.

notify-bot: reminder: create ticket "onboarding: KMS verify + CSV export" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
